item.name: Bookings
item.description: Reserving and cancelling a seat on a time slot.

request.description:
Reserves a seat on the given time slot. Protected against overselling
by a database row lock, so this is safe to call concurrently for the
same time slot. Rate limited to 5 requests/minute per user.

Frees the seat back to the time slot. Only the booking's owner or an
admin may cancel it; cancelling an already-cancelled booking is a no-op.

item.name: Payment Webhooks
item.description:
Called directly by Stripe, not by API clients. Authenticated by verifying
the `Stripe-Signature` header rather than a Sanctum token.

request.description:
Handles `checkout.session.completed` (confirms the booking's payment)
and `checkout.session.async_payment_failed` / `.expired` (marks the
booking as payment_failed). Idempotent: redelivering the same event id
is a no-op.

item.name: Resources
item.description:
Bookable resources (e.g. a class or a room). Reading requires any
authenticated user; creating, updating, and deleting require an admin.
